app.title: Valheim Achievement Tracker
app.footer: Game data from Valheim {0} · Unofficial fan tool, not affiliated with Iron Gate or Coffee Stain
pwa.installHint: Install as an app that also works offline
pwa.updateReady: A new version of the site is available.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: Sorry, the page you are looking for doesn't exist.
share.title: Share a link
share.info: The link contains the header, the eligibility banner and all achievement progress. Raw data is never included. Anyone with the link can see this data.
share.includeCharacter: Include the Character tab (makes the link longer)
share.banner: Shared snapshot, created {0} with game data {1}.
share.bannerNote: Raw data isn't part of shared links.
share.invalid: This share link is damaged or incomplete.
share.outdated: This share link was created with different achievement data and can no longer be shown.
share.unknownData: This share link needs game data this site doesn't have.
error.notASave: This doesn't look like a Valheim character file (.fch).
error.damaged: The file is damaged and couldn't be read.
error.olderVersion: This character was saved by an older Valheim version (profile format {0}). Load it once in Valheim 1.0.15 or newer, then try again.
error.newerVersion: This character was saved by a newer Valheim version (profile format {0}), which this site doesn't support yet.
error.tooLarge: That file is too large to be a Valheim character save.
warning.NewerVersion: Saved by a newer game version (profile format {0}); some data may be wrong.
warning.PlayerDataUnreadable: Character data (inventory, skills…) couldn't be read: {0}
warning.TrailingBytes: {0} unexpected bytes after the profile data.
warning.NewerPlayerDataVersion: Character data format {0} is newer than this site knows; inventory, skills and other details may be wrong.
warning.NewerInventoryVersion: Inventory format {0} is newer than this site knows; items may be shown incorrectly.
drop.title: Drop your character file here
drop.subtitle: or click to choose a .fch file (Valheim 1.0.15 or newer)
drop.whereTitle: Where to find your character file
drop.cloudHint: Steam Cloud is the default for Steam players. <id> is the numbered folder of your Steam account; if Steam is installed elsewhere, look in its userdata folder.
drop.privacy: Your file is read entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
demo.title: No save file at hand? Look at an example character:
demo.newcomerHint: A few evenings in: bronze gear, 2 bosses defeated
demo.banner: This is a made-up example character, so it can't be shared. Load your own save to see your progress.
elig.title.PermanentlyBlocked: Achievements are permanently disabled for this character
elig.detail.Eligible: No cheat markers found: the dev-command flag is off and no inventory item is marked as cheated.
elig.detail.TemporarilyBlocked: The inventory holds items created with dev commands. Drop or destroy them and progress resumes.
elig.detail.Bypassed: Dev commands were used, but the 'yesiuseddevcommandsbutiwantmyachievementsanyway' setting is on.
elig.detail.PermanentlyBlocked: Dev commands were used on this character. The game never clears this flag.
elig.worldNote: World modifiers set with dev commands and modded games also block achievements, but that isn't stored in the character file.
ach.noMatch: No achievements match the current filters.
details.lenient: Lenient: each category counts up to 115 % of its target, and the capped total must exceed the sum of all targets. Counts are the pieces you built that were loaded around you when you last placed a piece.
details.lenientMet: This one is met through leniency.
details.dynamic: This list is rebuilt from the game data the same way the game builds it.
note.TreeTypePickupQuirk: Tree-type counts exceed your tree deaths ({0}). A game data bug makes picking Thistle, Glowworms, cave crystals, Frost-core hangers and Kale seeds count as TreeBirch.
char.noData: This save has no readable character data.
char.vitalsNote: As saved; maximums include food active at save time.
char.inventoryLegend: {0} items · gold border = equipped · red = cheated
char.outsideGrid: Some items are outside the visible grid (e.g. equipment slots).
char.trophy.pending: Doesn't count yet: {0}. Not picked up since update 1.0.15 with achievements enabled; drop them and pick them up again.
raw.filter: Filter all tables (name, key or value)
raw.help.RawStats: Everything, including activity while cheated. Stats from before the 1.0.15 update live only here.
raw.help.Any: Counts toward achievements only while the character was clean (or bypass was on).
raw.help.Hammer: Not used by the current game version.
raw.help.difficulty: Recorded while playing on this combat difficulty. Enemy kills also count for every easier difficulty.
raw.col.name: Name
raw.f.name: Character name
stat.DeathByEdgeOfWorld: Death at the edge of the world
stat.TreeSwamp: Killed by an ancient swamp tree
hint.DeathByDrowning: Run out of stamina while swimming
hint.DeathByFreezing: The Freezing status effect (cold without frost resistance)
hint.DeathByEdgeOfWorld: Go over the edge of the world
hint.DeathByTree: Hit by a falling tree trunk
hint.treeType: Killed by the first trunk falling from this tree type
hint.explore: Be more than 10,350 m from the world centre in this direction while moving
hint.exploreNoMap: Same, with the No Map world modifier on
hint.buildCluster: Loaded pieces you built with this usage tag
hint.MaxBuildingHeight: Height above terrain of a piece placed on your own foundation
hint.MaxBuildingHeightWorld: World height of a piece placed outdoors on your own foundation
hint.BuiltPiecesNoDebt: Hammer placements; each removed piece cancels one later placement
hint.CraftFood: Food crafted from a crafting menu (cooking stations don't count)
hint.HarvestCrop: Planted crops harvested (seed crops don't count)
hint.LeviathanSink: Be near a Leviathan when it dives
hint.DistanceSail: Meters travelled aboard a ship. Steam shows a separate, lower counter (fractions dropped) with its own target
hint.DistanceSailHelm: Meters travelled while steering. Steam shows a separate, lower counter (fractions dropped) with its own target
hint.ConsecutiveDaysSurvivedMax: Longest streak of mornings without dying
hint.BossKillSolo: Boss killed with you as the only attacker
hint.BossKillMultiplayer: Boss killed with two or more players attacking
